about.title: Über die Meisterschaft
about.text: Beauty Dynastya ist ein internationaler Online-Wettbewerb für Beauty-Profis. Du nimmst direkt aus deinem Studio teil, egal wo auf der Welt – und deine Arbeit wird von einer internationalen Jury aus Top-Expertinnen der Branche bewertet.

process.title: So funktioniert's
process.lead: Von der Anmeldung bis zum Ergebnis – Schritt für Schritt.

registration.title: Anmeldung
registration.description: Wähle deine Kategorie und Disziplin, fülle das Anmeldeformular aus und bestätige deine Teilnahme.

preparation.title: Vorbereitung
preparation.description: Erstelle deine Wettbewerbsarbeit nach den Regeln deiner Kategorie.

submission.title: Einreichung
submission.description: Lade ein Foto oder Video hoch, prüfe Qualität und Anforderungen und reiche fristgerecht ein.

evaluation.title: Jurybewertung
evaluation.description: Internationale Jurorinnen bewerten jede Arbeit nach festgelegten Kriterien: Technik, Qualität und Ästhetik.

results.title: Ergebnisse
results.description: Punkte und Platzierungen werden in einer offiziellen Bekanntgabe veröffentlicht.

awards.title: Preisverleihung
awards.description: Die Gewinnerinnen erhalten Diplome und Auszeichnungen, die ihr Portfolio stärken.

alexandra-andreea.bio: Lash artist with 5 years in the UK, founder of the ZeroGravity Concept and NikolaLash Academy. Judge at Lash Global Dubai and Mondial Beauty Championship. Presented by Beauty Panda.

marzena-laskowska.bio: Lash artist, junior judge and independent beauty trainer. 4 trophies at live lash championships: 3 silver, 1 bronze. Presented by Beauty Panda.

gaia-proietti.bio: Lashmaker since 2024, trained at Concept Lashes and SA Academy Lash. Three podiums in extensions and lamination. Presented by Beauty Panda.

kateryna-nemchenko.bio: In lash extensions since 2020. Founder of BEAUTYPANDA, trainer in lash extensions, lash & brow lamination and PMU. Multi-award winner, IBA Beauty Awards laureate.

caren-betancourt.bio: Founder of Concepts of Beauty, trainer in lash & brow lamination with a focus on Korean techniques. 1st places at Divine Lash Champions, Beauty Revolution Austria and LamiDay Rome. Judge at Lashèra and Venice Beauty Congress.

letizia-barone.bio: Lashmaker since 2018, educator for Sopracciglieria Italiana. International podiums in extensions, lamination and henna. 2026 International Beauty Awards: Top Lami Trainer and Rising Star in the Lash Industry; opened her own academy the same year.

tsveti-ivanova.bio: Certified lash artist and founder of Cffety Lashes. Classic, hybrid, volume, wispy, anime and custom lash styling.

giulia-mascolo.bio: Lash artist and trainer since 2020. Lash & brow lamination, Korean Lash Lift. Award-winning competitor.

daniela-ndreu.bio: Master educator at a leading Italian lash extension academy, international judge and champion of several lash competitions.

diana-caprar.bio: 6+ years in the field and a trainer for 2+ years with over 300 students.

annalisa-milano.bio: Lash lifting and extensions. 1st place junior at WBC Beauty Champ and LamiDay Rome, 2nd place junior at the European Lash Championship.

yulia-shepel.bio: International lash judge, award-winning lash artist and educator.

silvia-sicuro.bio: Lash artist and trainer with 11 years of experience. Two podium placements in lash competitions.

alina-brikuna.bio: Lash artist with 4 years of experience. Lash Diva Championship 2026 (Riga): 1st place volume 2D–3D, 2nd place classic. Wink of Beauty: two 3rd places.

shiran-shalom.bio: PMU artist specialising in the ombré technique. Trained in Israel, Ukraine and Belgium; teaches lip PMU.

katy-pinchasov.bio: Owner of a private clinic in Sderot. Brows, lips and eyes; PMU and tattoo removal, microneedling.

zofiya-yadayi.bio: Brows, lips, eyes and tattoos; runs advanced courses. Multiple 1st places for eyeliner, lips and brow cover-up (2025–2026).

celine-vermeille.bio: Tattoo and PMU artist, founder of Dahlia Studio. Hairstroke brows, fine-line and scar tattooing, 3D areola reconstruction. 1st places in 3D Areola Reconstruction and Fine Line Tattoo.

marzena-guenther.bio: In beauty since 2004, PMU since 2017, certified Linergist. Grand Prix and two Polish Champion titles at PMU Gold Championship 2026. Judge at Amber Eyes, PMU Indonesia and Worlds Poland 2026.

angelica-betancourt.bio: Founder of Angelica Nails Academy, 10+ years in the nail industry, mentored 100+ nail artists. Nail reconstruction and architecture: gel, acrylic, acrygel, airbrush, nail art.

angela-betancourt.bio: Nail trainer & educator with 10+ years of experience, co-founder of Angelica Nails Academy, branding trainer and content creator.

anna-barnakova.bio: International nail trainer and owner of a nail salon in Michalovce. Winner of the Top 10 Nail Artist title and the Top Nail Trainer award.

julia-beauty.bio: World Champion 2025 (thin hair, Hair Extensions Guru Championship), IBA Beauty Awards XIII laureate, IBIA Level 5 international judge. Founder of Julia Beauty Academy and author of The 3D Layers Capsules Method™.

silvia-amadei.label: VIP-Speakerin
silvia-amadei.bio: Master trainer since 2024 and founder of SA Academy Lash & Brows (December 2025). Teaches professional lash & brow techniques and created the FOXYLAMI effect — a Korean lamination technique.

isabella-paunescu.bio: Founder of Regal Lashes and Regal Event UK — the first lash extension event in the UK organised by a Romanian woman. 9+ years in the lash industry and creator of the international community The REGAL Family.

beauty-panda.label: Offizieller Sponsor
beauty-panda.bio: Beauty Panda ist eine italienische Marke für professionelle Produkte zur Wimpernverlängerung. Das Aushängeschild LaserFix™: Wimpern und Pre-made Fans mit 360°-Laser-Mikroeinschnitten an der Basis – für längere Haltbarkeit und kein Verdrehen beim Applizieren.

registration.title: Jetzt teilnehmen
registration.text: Anmeldung und alle Details findest du in unserer Telegram-Gruppe. Tritt bei, nenne deine Kategorie – und wir schicken dir das Reglement und die Anleitung zur Einreichung deiner Arbeit.
registration.note: Die Gewinnerinnen erhalten einen Pokal, eine Urkunde und eine offizielle VIP-Card.
